target_customer: B2B companies with inbound demo and lead forms and a sales team that needs fast qualification and routing
problem: Inbound leads are slow to qualify and route to the right rep. Salesform qualifies, enriches, routes and converts them while syncing two ways with the sales stack.

founders.name: Uday Singh
previous_startups: Local Groupon competitor built in high school
founders.background_notes: From the YC page: worked on compiler development, building a type-inferred Lisp for the web, and NLP at Epigrammar.

technical_complexity.rationale: Form handling, enrichment and CRM two-way sync are standard integration work for a solo technical founder.

defensibility.rationale: Routing rules embedded in a CRM workflow create some stickiness, but the category is crowded with larger tools and the features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not verified for 2020. Current comparison pages show LeanData and Chili Piper as established routing vendors. Salesform did not appear in any comparison I found.

market_need_then: Speed to lead and routing for inbound demand requests is a recognized sales ops problem, but no dated 2020 evidence was found in opened sources.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name resembling Salesforce, and searches for the name returned Salesforce results; no brand press or community found.

outcome_analysis: Salesform remains an active tiny team with no verified funding or press coverage beyond directory listings. Aggregators report between 125 thousand and 500 thousand dollars raised with conflicting rounds, and one revenue tracker reports no outside capital. With Chili Piper and LeanData established in routing, the company looks like a small niche tool with no public sign of breakout traction.
notes: Funding is aggregator only and conflicting (CB Insights 500K over 3 rounds with a placeholder-looking 2023-01 seed led by Geek Ventures; PitchBook 125K; Latka no outside funding and about 900K revenue; Bouncewatch a 2020-08 pre-seed from Botware Ventures), so no rounds are recorded. PitchBook names co-founders Michael MacKay and Kwasi Oppong-Badu, unconfirmed by a company source, so not listed. salesform.com returned 503 on two attempts, so the company site was not read. Competitor search produced only 2025 and 2026 comparison pages, none listing Salesform, so the list is empty.
